name.en: Makyura, Destructor of the Sun God
name.ja: <ruby>太<rt>たい</rt></ruby><ruby>陽<rt>よう</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt>しん</rt></ruby>の<ruby>処<rt>しょ</rt></ruby><ruby>刑<rt>けい</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt>にん</rt></ruby>－マキュラ
name.zh-CN: 太阳神的处刑人－摩修罗

text.en: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned, or sent from the hand or field to the GY: You can Set 1 "Sun God" Spell/Trap from your hand or Deck, and if you Set a Trap or Quick-Play Spell, it can be activated this turn. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Makyura, Destructor of the Sun God" once per turn.
text.zh-CN: 此卡名的①②效果1回合仅可各使用1次。①：此卡召唤・特殊召唤的情况下，或从手牌・场上被送至墓地的情况下可以发动。从手牌・牌组将1张“太阳神”魔法・陷阱卡放置在自己场上。放置了速攻魔法・陷阱卡的情况下，该卡在放置的回合也可以发动。②：此回合有“不死之太阳神”被送至自己墓地的情况下，在结束阶段可以发动。将墓地的此卡加入手牌。
